subject: [PATCH v4 3/4] mm/huge_memory: add a per-order counter for underused splits

reviews.author: Usama Arif
reviews.summary: Reviewer noted the need to update thp_underused_split_page in /proc/vmstat to use 'PMD mapped THP' instead of 'THP', and approved the patch (LGTM) while giving an Acked-by tag.
reviews.raw_body:
In this same commit, would you mind also doing s/THP/PMD mapped THP/ in
thp_underused_split_page section in /proc/vmstat section?

Apart from that, LGTM

Acked-by: Usama Arif <usama.arif@linux.dev>

2026-11-03.patch_summary: This patch adds a per-order counter for underused huge page splits in the Linux kernel's memory management system. The existing thp_underused_split_page counter only counts PMD-sized folios, but this change introduces a new split_underused stat that tracks underused splits of all sizes. This is done to match the behavior of other THP split stats and provide more accurate information about huge page usage. The patch makes changes to several files, including Documentation/admin-guide/mm/transhuge.rst, include/linux/huge_mm.h, and mm/huge_memory.c.

reviews.author: Kiryl Shutsemau
reviews.summary: Reviewer pointed out a typo in the patch description, correcting 'PMD-mapped' to 'PMD-size', and gave his Reviewed-by tag
reviews.raw_body:
PMD-size, not PMD-mapped. But yes, it would be nice to update.

With that updated, feel free to use my

Reviewed-by: Kiryl Shutsemau (Meta) <kas@kernel.org>

-- 
  Kiryl Shutsemau / Kirill A. Shutemov

reviews.author: Joanne Koong (author)
reviews.summary: Author acknowledges the need to add a per-order counter for underused splits, agrees to include it in v5, and thanks reviewers for their feedback.
reviews.raw_body:
I will make this update for v5. Thanks for reviewing this series,
Usama and Kiryl.
